mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_delivery_scope s JOIN com_sales_order_line l ON l.id=s.order_line_id AND l.tenant_id=s.tenant_id JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.allocation_confirmed=0
mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.* FROM com_sales_order_line l JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND o.deleted=0 JOIN com_contract c ON c.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.contract_no=#{query.contractNo} JOIN com_project_contract_relation cr ON cr.contract_id=c.id AND cr.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cr.deleted=0 WHERE l.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND l.deleted=0 AND cr.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND cr.status='ACTIVE' AND (cr.effective_from IS NULL OR cr.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (cr.effective_to IS NULL OR cr.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND l.order_no=#{query.orderNo} AND l.line_no=#{query.lineNo} AND l.product_code=#{query.productCode} AND CAST(l.order_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.orderNo} AS BINARY) AND CAST(l.line_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.lineNo} AS BINARY) AND CAST(l.product_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.productCode} AS BINARY) AND l.source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND l.source_system=o.source_system AND l.company_code=o.company_code AND l.order_type=o.order_type AND l.status='ENABLED' AND o.status='ENABLED' AND ( (CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_order_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.order_id=o.id AND r.contract_id=c.id AND r.deleted=0 AND r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) )
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND source_evidence=#{query.evidence}
